title: The National park in the hills
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：national　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 national 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the ranger wrote of ① a national park in the hills in the survey, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② so national that nobody in the valley would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the ranger, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the national ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the national park in the hills that anybody there had ever seen, or so the survey for October 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too national to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the villager who had come to help; the national ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a national newspaper of the capital, and said that no villager in his right mind would call it ⑥ as national as the newspaper of the capital they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was national or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was ⑦ something national, and nothing besides. The villager from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite national; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the survey kept the names of the national ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, for the whole place, she wrote of another national park in the hills in the same survey, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less national than anybody had expected. ⑩ The national newspaper of the capital that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the national ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 国家（前置定语 a national park in the hills：1954 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的那件国家的公园）
B. adj. 国家／全国（两处加强说法：so national that … 与 no less national than …）
C. adj. 国家／全国（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 国家（表语 too national to do：母亲觉得它太国家，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 全国（前置定语 a national newspaper of the capital：叔叔把整件事称作一桩全国的性报纸）
F. adj. 全国（同级比较 as national as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩首都的全国性报纸相比）
G. adj. 全国（后置定语 something national：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 全国（受程度副词修饰 quite national：那位村民的评价）

items.q: a national park in the hills
the national park in the hills that
a national newspaper of the capital
The national newspaper of the capital that

answers.why: national 意为“国家”，1954 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的是“一件国家的公园”，此处作前置定语 a national park in the hills。
national 意为“国家”，此处用 so national that 结构，说它国家到山谷里没人敢靠近。
national 意为“国家”，踏勘记录上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的国家山里的国家公园，等于最高级的说法。
national 意为“国家”，母亲认为这件东西“太国家了，谁也用不上”，too national to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
national 意为“全国”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩全国的性报纸”，此处作前置定语 a national newspaper of the capital。
national 意为“全国”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩首都的全国性报纸一样全国”，同级比较用 as national as。
national 意为“全国”，踏勘记录上那半行字要的是“全国的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something national。
national 意为“全国”，邻山谷来的那位村民认为这套计划“相当全国”，quite 修饰原级 national。
national 意为“全国”，no less national than 表示“其全国不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之全国不亚于任何人的预料。
national 意为“全国”，母亲 1966 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的全国性报纸”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，守林人在踏勘记录里记下了一件国家的公园。（a national park in the hills）
它国家到山谷里没有一个人敢靠近。（so national that …）
母亲觉得它太国家，谁也用不上。（too national to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩全国的性报纸。（a national newspaper of the capital）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩首都的全国性报纸一样全国。（as national as …）
到了 1961 年，踏勘记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件全国的东西。（something national）
answers: In 1954 the ranger wrote of a national park in the hills in the survey.
It was so national that nobody in the valley would go near it.
My mother thought it too national to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a national newspaper of the capital.
He said nobody would call it as national as the newspaper of the capital they had once had.
By 1961 the survey asked for nothing but something national.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 national 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the ranger wrote of a national park in the hills in the survey, and nobody forgot it.
It was the national park in the hills that anybody there had ever seen, or so the survey says.
My mother thought it too national to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a national newspaper of the capital, and nobody argued with him.
The villager from the next valley called the plan quite national, and everybody laughed.
The national ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
